thread:
olivia: FYI I ran an nsys capture on yesterday's canary and compared it to the previous green. Saw a strange 12-18ms tailing on the selection timeline for batches >8.
sam: Interesting — is that in kernel launch time or idle gaps between kernels?
olivia: Looks like idle gaps. Kernel times steady, but there's ~10-20ms gaps where nothing is on CUDA, then a burst. Perfetto shows a 'micro-sleep' like gap aligned with KV cache warmup.
mira: Can you paste the nsys cmd you used? I'll run it locally too.
olivia: Sure, I used:```bash
nsys profile -o /tmp/trace_before --trace=cuda,osrt -w true --sample=thread --capture-range=none --force-overwrite --duration=30s -- python run_inference.py --batch 12
```
then same on canary.
sam: Reproduced locally. The gap correlates with an allocator call coming from kv_shard::ensure_prefetch. There's a host->device memcpy kicked off, then scheduler waits for completion before dispatching next tile.
ken: Is the memcpy big? maybe it's blocking the default stream.
olivia: It's small (few KB) but on dedicated stream 3. The problematic commit is 9b3f4a2 where we changed stream synchronization to avoid reorder issues. Bisect points there.
mira: I pulled 9b3f4a2 and profiled — gap disappears. So that commit introduced additional cudaEvent/sync.
sam: Could be we added an implicit cudaDeviceSynchronize in the error path, or mistakenly used cudaStreamSynchronize instead of event recording.
deploy-bot: deploy-canary 2026-03-11T09:12:05Z rolled: sha=main@f1a2b3c -> canary@e9d8c7b
ken: Quick mitigation: change the KV prefetch to use cudaEventRecord + cudaStreamWaitEvent on target stream, avoid host sync. That should keep ordering but not stall host scheduling.
mira: I patched locally to an event-based wait, re-ran nsys. Gap reduced to ~1-2ms (within noise).
olivia: Nice. Can someone open a tiny PR with test coverage? Also add a perf regression test comparing selection timeline P95 before/after with batch sweeps.
sam: I'll draft the PR and include the before/after perfetto links and the minimal repro script. Perfetto URLs: https://ui.perfetto.dev/trace/abcd1234 (before), https://ui.perfetto.dev/trace/efgh5678 (after).
olivia: One more thing — add a log line when kv_shard does prefetching that includes shard id + bytes, so future traces are easier to map.
ken: Agree. Also add a unit for stream assignment function; it's subtle and we should lock its behavior.
mira: I'll own the PR. tagging @sam for review and @olivia for perf numbers. :thumbsup:
